card.name: Leading digit of a two-digit number
card.fires_on: A digit (1, 2, 3, 5) that starts a multi-digit number, just before the final digit, such as the 1 in 15 cents or the 2 in 20 mg. It appears in dose amounts and old prices.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: First digit of a dose number, followed by a zero and mg.
modes.example: Limit the dose of citalopram to a maximum of <<2>>0 mg per day.

modes.label: Old prices
modes.description: First digit of a price in cents in historical remarks.
modes.example: a first-run movie ticket in a neighborhood theater sold for <<1>>5 cents.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese measure-word and unit pieces, so it adds little that is clear, perhaps a number-continuation cue.
card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of a two-digit number, like the 2 in 20 mg or the 1 in 15 cents.
